Research index: 23 original C facts and 20 continuation or confusable C2 facts cover Alcohol, drugs and impaired-driving consequences.
Exam index: part A cites cover edition, publisher frontmatter and the physical testing page; no passing percentage or time limit is asserted.
VERIFY: ID-IMPAIRMENT-PERCENT — official percentage not printed; ID-IMPAIRMENT-TIME — official time limit unlocated; ID-IMPAIRMENT-EFFECTIVE — effective date unestablished.
VERIFY: ID-IMPAIRMENT-DYNAMIC — Current impaired-driving statutes, underage penalty branches, interlock requirements, prescription effects and insurance procedures require official legal or clinical review before release.
VERIFY: ID-IMPAIRMENT-MARKET — demand research missing; ID-IMPAIRMENT-COMPETITORS — competitor research missing.
Every open item stays assigned to the evidence or research owner in its originating chunk. Pedagogic priorities are not official topic weights.
VERIFY: ID-ALCOHOL-EQUIVALENCE-UNIT — Physical page one hundred twenty-nine compares one-and-a-half ounces of eighty-proof spirits, five ounces of wine and twelve ounces of beer, then says about an ounce of alcohol each. Wine and beer strengths are unspecified and the alcohol-unit statement needs clinical/source verification. The equivalence and ounce conversion are withheld rather than reproduced as a fact.
VERIFY: ID-IMPAIRMENT-CLINICAL-REVIEW — The source's alcohol metabolism, sobriety and substance-effect descriptions have not passed the reserved clinical review. No personal dose, elapsed-time-to-sober estimate or medication recommendation is supplied. Release of the clinical content remains blocked.
VERIFY: ID-IMPAIRMENT-LEGAL-CURRENCY — BAC thresholds, open-container scope, DUI sanctions and traffic-stop legal consequences are source descriptions only. Current statutes, exceptions and amendments have not completed the reserved legal review, so no current-law release is claimed.
VERIFY: ID-IMPAIRMENT-UNDATED-RISKS — Physical pages one hundred twenty-eight and one hundred twenty-nine give BAC-related crash-risk multipliers, beer-arrest share and alcohol/anger crash assertions without dated methods or populations. These statistics are withheld.
VERIFY: ID-DRINK-COUNT-ONSET — The two-through-four-drink impairment onset statement on physical page one hundred twenty-nine lacks individual, dose and time conditions. It is not taught as a threshold below which driving is safe.
VERIFY: ID-OPEN-CONTAINER-EXCEPTIONS — Physical page one hundred thirty summarizes an open-container prohibition and trunk/rear storage without enumerating vehicle or statutory exceptions. Source wording is retained, but universal legal applicability requires the legal review.
VERIFY: ID-SR22-SERIOUS-OFFENSE-SPAN — The serious-offense financial-responsibility condition begins on physical page one hundred twenty-seven and continues onto one hundred twenty-eight. The complete suspension-triggered three-year requirement needs a multi-page binding; it is not replaced with an unqualified serious-offense rule.
VERIFY: ID-DUI-UNDER21-PENALTY-AMBIGUITY — The under-twenty-one parentheticals in the general criminal-penalty list on physical page one hundred thirty-two do not establish which BAC branches they cover; the second-conviction jail parenthesis gives thirty days without a clear range relation. Underage jail and fine combinations are withheld pending exact current legal authority rather than inferred from the adult list.
VERIFY: ID-DUI-ENHANCED-PENALTIES — Physical page one hundred thirty-one says an alcohol concentration of at least zero point twenty has stiffer consequences, but the selected criminal-penalty list does not map that enhanced branch. The general adult table is source-described, not a complete sanction calculator.
VERIFY: ID-DUI-INTERLOCK-WORDING-CONFLICT — Physical page one hundred thirty-two says an interlock restriction will likely follow suspension, whereas one hundred twenty-seven says it is required after a DUI conviction unless the court orders otherwise. The modal difference is unresolved; no blanket likelihood or mandatory rule is silently chosen.
VERIFY: ID-TRAFFIC-STOP-SEARCH-SPAN — The do-not-make-sudden-moves-or-search-documents instruction starts on physical page one hundred thirty-two and completes on one hundred thirty-three. That complete negative instruction needs a multi-page binding; locally complete document-location and visible-hand instructions are covered.
VERIFY: ID-IMPAIRMENT-ILLUSTRATION-REVIEW — Any impairment charts or illustrations associated with the mapped pages have not received semantic image review. No image-derived risk curve or visual practice item is authored.
